answer: Stake-weighted admission with delayed vesting is the core defense. Each identity must lock a deposit plus a history bond, both slashed when the cluster detector flags it. Running N fakes costs N deposits plus bonds, while each fake draws only the diluted per-identity reward, so margin collapses before scale pays. An inlet filter rejects clones sharing one egress, a plume of correlated timing exposes scripted farms, and an onyx cap limits reward per proven address. Faking ends up strictly dearer than honest work.
